title: Computational Gene-finding
summary: A BioLang port of Computational Gene-finding: codons, reading frames, forward and reverse-strand ORFs, translation, and the source's reported ORF-length comparison, with all nine answers.

source.title: A Little Book of R for Bioinformatics by Avril Coghlan
source.note: Adapted from R and SeqinR to BioLang by OriClabs with attribution. All four figures displayed in the source chapter are included byte-for-byte. The unseeded random comparison is retained as its exact source image and reported value; no replacement random data are generated. This is not an official publication or endorsement by the original author.
